lifePath:1: Life Path 1 — Leader & pioneer. Your mission is to learn independence, take initiative, and break new ground in your chosen field. You're here to build something new, not follow someone else's path. Challenge: leading without dominating, and resting before exhaustion compounds. When you find your own courage, the 1 energy flows.
lifePath:2: Life Path 2 — Diplomat & connector. Your mission is to be a bridge, mediator, and collaborative force. You're emotionally attuned and have a natural gift for sensing dynamics between people. Challenge: learning to advocate for yourself, not only for others. Your sensitivity is a strength, not a weakness.
lifePath:3: Life Path 3 — Communicator & creative. Your mission is to express yourself — through words, art, or performance — and spread joy. You're here to lift the mood and inspire through creativity. Challenge: staying focused rather than jumping idea to idea, and not hiding behind humor when there are deep feelings to face.
lifePath:4: Life Path 4 — Builder & architect. Your mission is to create lasting structures, systems, or foundations. You're reliable, methodical, and practical. Challenge: learning flexibility when plans shift, and letting yourself enjoy the process, not only the result. Your hard work produces a real legacy.
lifePath:5: Life Path 5 — Explorer & freedom-bearer. Your mission is to learn through experience, change, and variety. You're here to taste many sides of life and help others release the bonds that limit them. Challenge: turning restlessness into directed curiosity, and committing to what truly matters.
lifePath:6: Life Path 6 — Nurturer & balancer. Your mission centers on love, responsibility, and harmony — family, community, justice. You're a natural caregiver with a strong aesthetic sense. Challenge: learning healthy limits — you can't rescue everyone, and over-sacrifice corrodes your capacity to love.
lifePath:7: Life Path 7 — Seeker & thinker. Your mission is to seek truth through reflection, study, and solitude. You're here to understand things deeply — spiritually, scientifically, or philosophically — rather than accept surface answers. Challenge: not withdrawing so far that you isolate. Trust and connection are your big lessons.
lifePath:8: Life Path 8 — Executor & manifestor. Your mission is to learn to manage resources, power, and the material world with integrity. You're here to turn ideas into reality at scale. Challenge: don't let obsession with money or status pull you away from relationships and meaning. True 8 power is material and spiritual balance.
lifePath:9: Life Path 9 — Humanitarian & completer. Your mission is to serve something larger than yourself — humanity, art, justice. You're here to release the past and give without strings attached. Challenge: learning to receive love and support, not only to give. Past sorrow must be released so you can show up fully.
lifePath:11: Life Path 11 — Illuminator (master). The high octave of Life Path 2, but with a much more demanding spiritual mission. You're here as an inspirer — a visionary who receives insight and channels it to others. Life will feel intense, often accompanied by a strong sense of mission. Challenge: confidence that swings up and down. When you accept the role of light source, the 11 energy flows.
lifePath:22: Life Path 22 — Master Builder. The high octave of Life Path 4. You're here to manifest large-scale visions that serve many people — businesses, organizations, movements, or work that lasts long beyond you. Challenge: the scale of 22 ambition can feel overwhelming; many drop into 4-mode to avoid it. When you dare to carry the weight of a big vision, your impact is immense.
lifePath:33: Life Path 33 — Master Teacher (very rare). The high octave of Life Path 6. You're here as a teacher-servant — healing, nurturing, and uplifting through unconditional love. Life often delivers hard lessons about sacrifice and compassion. Challenge: not dissolving into others' suffering. True 33 comes from fullness, not lack.
expression:1: Expression 1 — Talent for leading & initiating. You're naturally gifted at taking initiative, standing on your own, and being first. Others see you as a pioneer. Leading without dominating is your key skill.
expression:2: Expression 2 — Talent for connecting & collaborating. You're gifted at bridging people, deep listening, and reading the room. Your strength is teamwork, mediation, and detail.
expression:3: Expression 3 — Talent for communicating & creating. Your gift is in words, art, performance, and spreading positive energy. People remember you for how engagingly you express ideas.
expression:4: Expression 4 — Talent for building & organizing. You're gifted at creating systems, procedures, and lasting structures. Precision, patience, and persistence are your strengths.
expression:5: Expression 5 — Talent for versatility & broad communication. You're gifted at adapting, selling ideas, and exploring new things. Strong in marketing, sales, travel, and dynamic work.
expression:6: Expression 6 — Talent for nurturing & healing. You're gifted in people-centered work — teaching, counseling, healthcare, hospitality. Your aesthetic sense is strong.
expression:7: Expression 7 — Talent for analysis & research. You're gifted at digging deep — research, science, philosophy, or spirituality. Sharp mind and pattern-recognition strengths.
expression:8: Expression 8 — Talent for managing & manifesting. You're gifted in business, finance, and executive leadership. Strong at turning ideas into tangible material results.
expression:9: Expression 9 — Talent for service & humanitarian work. You're gifted in art, advocacy, or work that serves many. Your empathy reaches wide.
expression:11: Expression 11 — Talent for inspiring (master). You're gifted at channeling ideas and visions that move others. Strong in teaching, writing, and spiritual work.
expression:22: Expression 22 — Talent for building large vision (master). You're gifted at manifesting big ideas at real scale — businesses, institutions, movements. High execution capability.
expression:33: Expression 33 — Talent for teaching with love (master). You're gifted at healing and uplifting others through unconditional love and practical wisdom.
soulUrge:1: Soul Urge 1 — Yearns for independence. Your heart longs for the freedom to lead yourself, pursue a personal vision, and build something distinctly yours.
soulUrge:2: Soul Urge 2 — Yearns for connection. Your heart longs for harmony, deep partnership, and a safe space to be felt and heard without having to fight.
soulUrge:3: Soul Urge 3 — Yearns for expression. Your heart longs for the freedom to create, laugh, and be seen. Without a creative outlet you wither inside.
soulUrge:4: Soul Urge 4 — Yearns for stability. Your heart longs for security, structure, and order. Peace comes when everything is in its proper place.
soulUrge:5: Soul Urge 5 — Yearns for freedom. Your heart longs for variety, travel, and fresh experience. Restrictive commitment feels like a prison.
soulUrge:6: Soul Urge 6 — Yearns for love & nurturing. Your heart longs for a warm home, deep relationships, and the feeling of being needed by people you love.
soulUrge:7: Soul Urge 7 — Yearns for truth. Your heart longs for depth, productive solitude, and understanding the mysteries beneath the surface.
soulUrge:8: Soul Urge 8 — Yearns for power & achievement. Your heart longs for authority, resources, and the respect that comes from building something formidable.
soulUrge:9: Soul Urge 9 — Yearns for meaning. Your heart longs for a mission larger than yourself — to serve, heal, or create work that touches many.
soulUrge:11: Soul Urge 11 — Yearns for inspiration (master). Your heart longs to connect with a higher source and channel it into the world. A high spiritual quest.
soulUrge:22: Soul Urge 22 — Yearns for big impact (master). Your heart longs to manifest visions that serve many and outlast you.
soulUrge:33: Soul Urge 33 — Yearns to heal the world (master). Your heart longs to lift collective suffering through unconditional love and wisdom.
personality:1: Personality 1 — Reads as: confident & independent. People see you as a natural leader, unafraid to stand apart. Can feel intimidating to gentler types.
personality:2: Personality 2 — Reads as: warm & sensitive. People feel comfortable opening up to you. Can come across too passive to dominant types.
personality:3: Personality 3 — Reads as: expressive & entertaining. People are drawn to your energy — humor, style, openness. Can read as not serious to task-oriented types.
personality:4: Personality 4 — Reads as: reliable & organized. People see you as someone they can trust. Can feel rigid or overly serious on first contact.
personality:5: Personality 5 — Reads as: magnetic & dynamic. People see you as adventurous and unpredictable. Can feel inconsistent to those who need certainty.
personality:6: Personality 6 — Reads as: warm & caring. People immediately feel attended to. Can feel moralistic to those who feel watched.
personality:7: Personality 7 — Reads as: mysterious & intelligent. People see you as deep and private. Can read as cold or distant.
personality:8: Personality 8 — Reads as: powerful & ambitious. People sense authority in how you carry yourself. Can feel intimidating or materialistic.
personality:9: Personality 9 — Reads as: graceful & classy. People sense an aura of wisdom and empathy. Can feel too idealistic or removed from daily reality.
personality:11: Personality 11 — Reads as: magnetic & inspiring (master). People feel something special about you — often without being able to explain it.
personality:22: Personality 22 — Reads as: powerful & visionary (master). People see you as someone who can manifest big things. A quiet aura of authority.
personality:33: Personality 33 — Reads as: healer & teacher (master). People immediately feel uplifted around you. A deep aura of love.
birthday:1: Birthday 1 — Innate gift: independence. You came in with the courage to stand alone and decide without hesitation. Leadership is your birth gift.
birthday:2: Birthday 2 — Innate gift: sensitivity. You came in with the ability to read emotions and find middle ground. Diplomacy is your birth gift.
birthday:3: Birthday 3 — Innate gift: expression. You came in with the talent for words, storytelling, or creative work that draws attention. Joy comes naturally.
birthday:4: Birthday 4 — Innate gift: persistence. You came in with the patience and precision to finish what you start. Hard work doesn't feel like a burden.
birthday:5: Birthday 5 — Innate gift: adaptability. You came in with the ability to adjust quickly to new environments and absorb new experiences hungrily.
birthday:6: Birthday 6 — Innate gift: nurturing. You came in with affection and a sense of responsibility for those close to you. Aesthetic sense comes naturally.
birthday:7: Birthday 7 — Innate gift: analysis. You came in with a sharp mind that wants to understand cause and effect — never satisfied with shallow answers.
birthday:8: Birthday 8 — Innate gift: ambition. You came in with a strong drive to achieve tangible results in the material world. Authority comes naturally.
birthday:9: Birthday 9 — Innate gift: universal love. You came in with broad empathy and an attraction to meaning larger than yourself.
birthday:11: Birthday 11 — Innate gift: intuition (master). You came in with high spiritual sensitivity and the ability to receive insight without formal study.
birthday:22: Birthday 22 — Innate gift: vision architect (master). You came in with the rare ability to see the big picture and know how to build it.
personalYear:1: Personal Year 1 — New beginnings. The seed year: start a new chapter, take initiative, set the direction for the next 9-year cycle. Suited for moves, career changes, new ventures, or closing out old chapters. High independence energy — others won't carry you; you must take the step.
personalYear:2: Personal Year 2 — Relationships & patience. A year to build, not to plant. Focus on partnership, cooperation, and attention to detail. What you started last year needs time to mature — don't force it. Diplomacy beats confrontation this year.
personalYear:3: Personal Year 3 — Expression & creativity. A light, social, creative year. Suited for communicating, writing, making, expanding social circles. Watch energy scatter — many opportunities, easy to lose focus. Pick 1-2 creative projects and finish them.
personalYear:4: Personal Year 4 — Work & foundation. A year for steady, structural building. Not glamorous — lots of hard work, discipline, attention to detail. Finances, health, and home often take focus. What you build correctly this year will last.
personalYear:5: Personal Year 5 — Change & freedom. A year of travel, transition, and new opportunities. Many people move, change jobs, or travel far. Restless energy — use it for conscious exploration, not for fleeing commitments. The lesson is responsible freedom.
personalYear:6: Personal Year 6 — Love, home, & responsibility. A family, relationship, and commitment year. Marriage, birth, or building a home often falls in a 6 year. Responsibility to others rises — make sure you don't over-sacrifice yourself.
personalYear:7: Personal Year 7 — Reflection & study. An introspective, spiritual, inner-growth year. Not a year to chase the outer world — the energy slows. Suited for study, research, retreat, or letting go of what no longer fits. Many deep questions surface; let them mature you.
personalYear:8: Personal Year 8 — Material achievement. A harvest year — what you planted in year 1 starts to bear fruit. Focus on career, finance, power, and recognition. Big moves are possible. Watch the balance; 8 without integrity can lose what it won.
personalYear:9: Personal Year 9 — Completion & release. The last year of the 9-year cycle. Many things end — relationships, jobs, life phases. Release what's complete so the next year 1 can start clean. An emotional, service-oriented, reflective year.
personalMonth:1: Personal Month 1 — Start something. A good time to begin a new project, take initiative, or make an important decision. Independent energy.
personalMonth:2: Personal Month 2 — Build slowly. Focus on cooperation, detail, and patience. Not a time for aggressive pushes.
personalMonth:3: Personal Month 3 — Express yourself. A social, creative, communicative month. Great for presentations, networking, and creative work.
personalMonth:4: Personal Month 4 — Hard work. A month for foundations, organization, and finishing pending tasks. Discipline pays off.
personalMonth:5: Personal Month 5 — Change. A month of travel, plan changes, and unexpected opportunities. Stay flexible.
personalMonth:6: Personal Month 6 — Family & responsibility. Focus on home, relationships, or caregiving. A warm but demanding month.
personalMonth:7: Personal Month 7 — Reflection. A month for introspection, study, or retreat. Energy slows — use it for rest and analysis.
personalMonth:8: Personal Month 8 — Material action. A month for finance, career, and big decisions. Results can be tangible this month.
personalMonth:9: Personal Month 9 — Release & complete. A month for finishing, releasing, or ending. Clear space for what's new.
personalDay:1: Personal Day 1 — Start. A good day to begin something, take initiative, or make a first move.
personalDay:2: Personal Day 2 — Diplomacy. A day for relationships, listening, and cooperation. Avoid head-on confrontation.
personalDay:3: Personal Day 3 — Expression. A social, creative day. Great for communication, presentations, or creative work.
personalDay:4: Personal Day 4 — Work. A day for focus, detail, and finishing tasks. High discipline.
personalDay:5: Personal Day 5 — Variety. A dynamic day, plan changes, or new opportunities. Flexibility helps.
personalDay:6: Personal Day 6 — Responsibility. A day for family, home, or serving others. Warm and personal.
personalDay:7: Personal Day 7 — Reflection. A quieter day, suited for thinking, reading, or a brief retreat.
personalDay:8: Personal Day 8 — Execution. A strong day for financial decisions, negotiation, or professional moves.
personalDay:9: Personal Day 9 — Complete. A day for finishing, releasing, or clearing dangling matters.
pinnacle:1: Pinnacle 1 — Independence chapter. You're called to lead yourself, develop courage, and pioneer. Situations will force you to stand alone. Don't get aggressive; true leadership comes from quiet self-trust.
pinnacle:2: Pinnacle 2 — Partnership chapter. Lessons in cooperation, sensitivity, and diplomacy. Relationships take center stage — marriage, collaboration, or support networks. Learn to advocate for yourself without losing the ability to cooperate.
pinnacle:3: Pinnacle 3 — Expression chapter. Creative, social, and communication talents flourish. Many opportunities to speak, write, or perform. Watch energy scatter — pick one creative path and develop it seriously.
pinnacle:4: Pinnacle 4 — Hard-work chapter. Building stable foundations — career, finances, family. Not much glamour, but much growth through persistence. What you build in this chapter lasts.
pinnacle:5: Pinnacle 5 — Change chapter. Lots of motion, travel, and transformation. You'll be pushed out of comfort zones. Core lesson: responsible freedom. Don't flee commitments — learn when to stay and when to go.
pinnacle:6: Pinnacle 6 — Love & responsibility chapter. Family, relationships, and community move to the center. You're called to nurture and balance. Learn to give without losing yourself; draw healthy lines.
pinnacle:7: Pinnacle 7 — Reflection & spirituality chapter. An introspective chapter — much time alone, study, or inner growth. May feel materially slow but inwardly deep. Trust the process; wisdom comes from conscious solitude.
pinnacle:8: Pinnacle 8 — Power & achievement chapter. Lessons in managing resources, money, and authority. Big material opportunities. Watch the balance — 8 without integrity corrodes; with integrity, builds legacy.
pinnacle:9: Pinnacle 9 — Service & release chapter. A humanitarian chapter — you're called to serve something larger. Many things end so the new can begin. Learn to give without strings, then to receive with grace.
pinnacle:11: Pinnacle 11 — Inspiration chapter (master). An intense spiritual chapter — you're called as a source of inspiration or teacher. High pressure but high impact potential.
pinnacle:22: Pinnacle 22 — Vision-building chapter (master). A chapter for manifesting big ideas that serve many. High execution pressure, but also legacy potential.
pinnacle:33: Pinnacle 33 — Teacher-servant chapter (master). A chapter of healing and teaching through unconditional love. Very emotionally demanding.
challenge:0: Challenge 0 — Pervasive challenge. You're tested across many areas at once. Key: pick a core value and let it guide every choice.
challenge:1: Challenge 1 — Independence challenge. Learning to stand on your own without leaning too hard on authority or others. Speak up for yourself.
challenge:2: Challenge 2 — Sensitivity challenge. Learning to manage sensitivity without being swept up in others' emotions. Hold healthy boundaries.
challenge:3: Challenge 3 — Expression challenge. Learning to express yourself honestly, not hiding behind humor or holding back creativity from fear of judgment.
challenge:4: Challenge 4 — Discipline challenge. Learning to work hard without rigidity — flexible when plans change, still focused on results.
challenge:5: Challenge 5 — Freedom challenge. Learning to use freedom responsibly — not fleeing commitments, not trapped in routine.
challenge:6: Challenge 6 — Responsibility challenge. Learning to give without losing yourself. Draw lines — you can't save everyone.
challenge:7: Challenge 7 — Trust challenge. Learning to trust people and the process. Don't withdraw so far that you isolate.
challenge:8: Challenge 8 — Power challenge. Learning to manage money and authority with integrity. Don't compromise values for material achievement.
cycle:1: Period Cycle 1 — Independence cycle. Decade theme: learning to stand alone, make decisions, and build a personal identity.
cycle:2: Period Cycle 2 — Partnership cycle. Decade theme: relationships, cooperation, and sensitivity to the important people in your life.
cycle:3: Period Cycle 3 — Expression cycle. Decade theme: creating, communicating, and developing your creative voice.
cycle:4: Period Cycle 4 — Foundation cycle. Decade theme: hard work, building structure — career, family, health, finances.
cycle:5: Period Cycle 5 — Change cycle. Decade theme: travel, transition, and exploring many sides of life.
cycle:6: Period Cycle 6 — Responsibility cycle. Decade theme: family, community, deep relationships, and developing care.
cycle:7: Period Cycle 7 — Reflection cycle. Decade theme: study, introspection, and inner growth — often through conscious solitude.
cycle:8: Period Cycle 8 — Achievement cycle. Decade theme: career, finances, power, and manifesting material visions.
cycle:9: Period Cycle 9 — Service cycle. Decade theme: serving something larger, releasing the past, preparing for a new cycle.
cycle:11: Period Cycle 11 — Inspiration cycle (master). A decade with intense spiritual mission — you become a channel for insight and inspiration.
cycle:22: Period Cycle 22 — Big-vision cycle (master). A decade for manifesting large-scale work that serves many.
karmicLesson:1: Karmic Lesson 1 — Learning independence & self-leadership. The 1 energy is absent from your name, so the courage to stand alone doesn't come automatically. You may lean too much on authority or a partner. How to develop: start with small decisions you make alone without seeking validation, then scale up. Practice saying 'no' without apology.
karmicLesson:2: Karmic Lesson 2 — Learning sensitivity & collaboration. The 2 energy is absent — you may be too aggressive, impatient with detail, or frustrated with people who move slower. How to develop: practice listening without preparing your answer, attend to others' feelings before speaking, work in teams rather than solo.
karmicLesson:3: Karmic Lesson 3 — Learning self-expression. The 3 energy is absent — you struggle to communicate feelings, often suppress creativity, or feel stiff when expected to create. How to develop: start journaling, take classes that involve expression (writing, painting, theater), practice speaking up in small safe groups.
karmicLesson:4: Karmic Lesson 4 — Learning discipline & persistence. The 4 energy is absent — you may jump project to project without finishing, lack patience for incremental processes, or fall apart on tedious execution. How to develop: pick one project and commit to finishing, build daily routines, practice patience with non-instant outcomes.
karmicLesson:5: Karmic Lesson 5 — Learning adaptability & release. The 5 energy is absent — you're too rigid, afraid of change, or stuck in routines that no longer serve you. How to develop: deliberately try new things weekly, take small trips, change the route to work, practice releasing control of small things.
karmicLesson:6: Karmic Lesson 6 — Learning responsibility & nurturing. The 6 energy is absent — you may dodge commitment, struggle to be fully present for others, or feel burdened when people need you. How to develop: start with small commitments you consistently keep, show up fully when close people need support, practice caring without fleeing.
karmicLesson:7: Karmic Lesson 7 — Learning reflection & spirituality. The 7 energy is absent — you're too busy with the outer world, rarely give yourself stillness, or reject the contemplative side. How to develop: brief daily meditation, read challenging philosophy or spirituality, let yourself have alone time without guilt.
karmicLesson:8: Karmic Lesson 8 — Learning power & material management. The 8 energy is absent — you may be uncomfortable with money, authority, or visible ambition; you tend to self-sabotage when material success arrives. How to develop: learn basic finance, practice asking for what you deserve, hold the authority you have without apology.
karmicLesson:9: Karmic Lesson 9 — Learning service & release. The 9 energy is absent — you're too focused on yourself, struggle to see the big picture, or reluctant to let go of what's done. How to develop: involve yourself in community service, practice giving without keeping score, release grudges or relationships that have completed with compassion.
